sentence_stem: The comic strip was very funny, so
full_sentence: The comic strip was very funny, so I laughed out loud.
acceptable_variants: I showed it to my friends.

options.text: I did not laugh at all.
options.why_wrong: This is the opposite of the expected result: a funny strip usually makes readers laugh.

options.text: it was printed in black and white.
options.why_wrong: This describes the paper, not a result of the strip being funny.
This is an unrelated fact, not a result of the strip being funny.

explanation: After 'so', we need the result of the situation described before it. A very funny strip leads to a reaction, so the correct result is the action of laughing. Portuguese speakers may be tempted to read 'so' as a word meaning 'because', but here it introduces a result.
translation: A tirinha era muito engraçada, então eu ri alto.
